candidates.summary: the ante's own out-of-gas recover still names tx.Fee.GasWanted as the limit for a 0-fee tx, whose meter was set to Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx; the diff fixed this sibling at ante.go:399-403 (success path) and baseapp.go:915-919 (the round-4 'OOG log names the PayGas limit' follow-up) but not here
candidates.failure_scenario: Window open (MaxGasCreditPerTx=1_000_000), a 0-fee tx whose txSize or signature gas exceeds 1M in the ante (e.g. a ~100KB addpkg at TxSizeCostPerByte=10), signed with GasWanted=50000: the meter limit is 1M, yet the log reads 'gas used (1000010) exceeds tx's gas wanted (50000)'; with GasWanted >= Block.MaxGas it reads 'exceeds max block gas'. The user is told to raise a gas-wanted that a 0-fee tx ignores. res.GasWanted at :143 is overwritten to 0 by runTx's defer on abort, so only the log text is wrong.
candidates.verify_by: ante unit test beside TestAnteHandlerRejectsSponsoredTxBeforeFirstBlock: ctx at height 1, cp.Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx=1000, params.TxSizeCostPerByte large enough to exceed 1000 on a test tx with fee std.NewFee(50000, std.NewCoin("ugnot",0)); assert res.Log contains 'gas wanted (1000)'; observe 'gas wanted (50000)'. Fix: pass the meter's limit (newCtx.GasMeter().Limit()) or the credit when isZeroFeeTx
candidates.evidence: grep -n: ante.go:140 'log := store.OutOfGasLog(gasUsed, tx.Fee.GasWanted, maxGas, ex.Descriptor, true)'; ante.go:401 'reportedGasWanted = consParams.Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx'; ante.go:122 'newCtx = SetGasMeter(ctx, consParams.Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx)'; baseapp.go:915-919 'limit := gasWanted; if l := ctx.GasMeter().Limit(); l > 0 && l < limit { limit = l }; log := store.OutOfGasLog(gasUsed, limit, ...)'

candidates.summary: a large maxFee panics 'maxFee * gas price overflows' only in a sponsored tx, although the limit is capped by the credit window anyway; saturating to the window would accept it
candidates.failure_scenario: A realm calls runtime.PayGas(math.MaxInt64, cur) meaning 'cap only by the window'. In gno test and in fee-paying txs PayGasInfo is nil or ineligible, so the call returns before line 44 and the realm's tests pass; in every 0-fee tx overflow.Mul(maxFee, gp.Gas) fails for gp.Gas >= 2 and the tx aborts, so the sponsorship never works on chain.
candidates.verify_by: txtar copied from paygas_basic.txtar with the realm calling runtime.PayGas(9223372036854775807, cur) in a 0-fee tx: expect success capped at the window, observe 'PayGas: maxFee * gas price overflows'
candidates.evidence: paygas.go: eligibility return at 'if pgi == nil || !pgi.Eligible { return }' precedes 'product, ok := overflow.Mul(maxFee, gp.Gas); if !ok { m.Panic(...overflows) }', then 'limit = min(limit, curLimit)'
